name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=read/bios, descriptor=midnight_tick). Accurately names the action: reads the BIOS midnight tick counter at BDA linear 0x46C (the ~18.2 Hz INT 8h tick count). No Ghidra address residue in the name (0x46C is the BDA hardware address, referenced in the body, not embedded as a name suffix). disasm confirms: PUSH ESI; XOR EAX,EAX; MOV ESI,0x46C; LODSW; POP ESI; RET.
purpose: Reads and returns the low 16 bits of the BIOS midnight tick counter (BDA linear 0x46C, ~18.2 Hz) for low-resolution frame timing without reprogramming the 8254 PIT.
logic_summary: Loads the 16-bit word at BDA linear address 0x46C (LODSW from ESI=0x46C with EAX pre-zeroed) and returns it. The C model is `return (uint16)BIOS_TICK_COUNT;` where BIOS_TICK_COUNT expands (production) to `*(volatile uint32 *)0x46CuL`, so the cast to uint16 takes the low word -- byte-identical to the binary's word load. No stack frame, no branches, single basic block.

returns.semantics: Low 16 bits of the 32-bit BIOS midnight tick counter at BDA 0x46C; wraps within the day at the 18.2 Hz tick rate (~55 ms per tick).

reads_globals: BDA_tick_count@0x46C (BIOS Data Area, via BIOS_TICK_COUNT macro = *(volatile uint32 *)0x46CuL; hardware/BDA address, not a data_fd2_ project global)
notes: Trivial BDA tick reader. 2 callers, both inside fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim (palette-cycle throttle compare + last-update timestamp). src comment (input.c lines 38-46) is already concise and accurate -> no Edit to input.c. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the src understanding (no contradiction) -> plate left unchanged. BIOS_TICK_COUNT has an #ifdef FD2_REPLAY deterministic-clock alias (consts.h:88) gated out of production; production path matches the binary byte-for-byte. No reads/writes of any data_fd2_ project global; only the fixed BDA hardware address 0x46C.
